title: SURF/UNL Read & Publish + Scopus — 2027 Extension Decision
notes: BIDDABLE. Current 2-year deal (Jan 2025–Dec 2026) includes optional 3rd-year extension to Dec 2027 requiring 90 days written notice — decision deadline ~1 Oct 2026. Covers 14 universities (UNL), 7 UMCs (NFU), NWO-i, KNAW, 23 hogescholen. If not extended: full open re-tender expected for 2028. Renewal negotiations active NOW.

title: ATU Ireland Library DPS — Science & Technology Lot
notes: TED 391344-2026 (OJ S 108/2026). Clarivate Analytics (UK) Ltd won the Science & Technology lot (Lot 14) at €119,230. Contract signed 3 June 2026, 12-month + 3 optional extensions. Elsevier Scopus displaced. 2 bids received. Re-tender window: mid-2027.

title: London Metropolitan University — Web of Science 2025-28
notes: UK Find-a-Tender 038505-2026. WoS subscription renewed via Jisc Collections, Oct 2025–Sep 2028, £95K ex-VAT. Awarded without competition (below threshold, Jisc national agreement). Elsevier Scopus not selected. Renewal window: Sep 2028.

title: Max Planck Society — EBSCO Electronic Databases 2025-2028
notes: TED 50580-2026 (OJ S 16/2026). Max Planck awarded EBSCO a sole-source contract Dec 2025–Dec 2028 for electronic specialist literature and databases. Awarded without competition — EBSCO cited exclusive IP/content rights under §14(4) VgV. Elsevier not invited to bid. Re-tender window: late 2028.
